answers.goal: Being a director and being able to facilitate and help manage a large project in feature film or games.
answers.drew: A passion for design for games and film. I grew up playing games similar to others in the field, and realizing that it could be a job only made me want to pursue it more. Although I’m shifting towards more production related roles, I still enjoy the creative nuance in the industry, and meeting people from all types of backgrounds.
answers.inspiration: This one’s hard, I think I look up to multiple people for different reasons. I admire the work of Christopher Nolan and Quentin Tarantino because I enjoy their films a lot! For concept art I really enjoy their work of Sergey Kolesov.
answers.favorite: Project Hail Mary, Obsession, Game of Thrones
